findings.title: Performance target lacks a load test and CI gate
findings.description: The slice restates a target of adding under one second to a Phase 0 build on local disk. Task 3T tests traversal caps, but those assertions do not measure that target. Add a load test under `tests/load/` covering the stated performance requirement and an explicit CI task that gates on it.

findings.title: Commit markers are checkboxes rather than plain lines
findings.description: The commit markers are written as checkbox tasks, starting with Task 2C, rather than plain `**Commit**:` lines. Convert them to plain markers while retaining their placement after tested work.

findings.title: Renderer tests do not cover every outcome
findings.description: The slice’s technical requirements call for `renderAdoptionFacts` tests for every outcome. Task 8T specifies brownfield, adoption-in-progress and the explicit-instruction outcome, but omits adoption-closed, already-planned and greenfield. Add cases for those outcomes to meet the stated criterion.
